comparison.objective: Wipe a monitor lead continuously from plug end to clip end.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold one end while executing a continuous, direction-constrained sliding pinch along a compliant lead.
comparison.success_condition: Required lead length wiped without backtracking, entire lead placed on drape, hands clear.
comparison.reason: Tests continuous traversal of a compliant cable, not rigid tool insertion, rotary adjustment, locking, or dynamic commissioning.
